create_schedule_policy: create a SchedulePolicy with a cache-aware or cache-agnostic scheduling strategy for request batching
calc_priority_waiting_queue: calculate priority ordering for a waiting queue of requests using longest prefix match or depth-first search weighting
add_one_req_prefill: add a single request to the prefill batch with token budget checks and chunked prefill support
add_chunked_req_prefill: add a chunked prefill request that fits within remaining token budget and returns truncated input length
preempt_to_schedule: preempt lower-priority running requests to make room for a higher-priority request in the prefill batch
